description:
Hardware prices are out of control, making this cheaper RTX 5060 laptop look like a steal. But is the Lenovo LOQ 15 a budget gaming laptop dream, or a trap?
Lenovo’s 2026 LOQ 15 looks like the ultimate lower cost solution for PC gamers, but there is a major catch hidden on the spec sheet: they power-limited the Nvidia RTX 5060 to just 65W.
In this Lenovo LOQ 15 review, we break down the specs, the build quality, and most importantly, the gaming benchmarks to see if this budget gaming laptop is actually worth your money. While an Intel Core i7 13650HX paired with 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 144Hz 1080p display sounds incredible for the price, a 65W TGP GPU can severely bottleneck modern AAA games.
